# Pixel Tic-Tac-Toe

A two-player tic-tac-toe game with a pixel-art aesthetic, built with only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript. Works fully offline.

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Features

- Two players: X always goes first
- Live turn indicator (announced via `aria-live`)
- Win detection with highlighted winning line
- Draw detection
- Restart button to reset the game
- Keyboard-accessible cells and controls with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Pixel-style visuals using CSS only (no external assets)

## Controls

- Click or tap a cell to place your mark
- Press `Tab` to move focus between cells and the Restart button
- Press `Enter` or `Space` to activate a focused cell or button

## Palette

| Color | Use |
|-------|-----|
| `#1a1a2e` | Background |
| `#16213e` | Card background |
| `#0f3460` | Cell background |
| `#e94560` | Accent (X, restart button) |
| `#f5c518` | Highlight (winning line, focus ring) |

## Files

- `index.html` — page structure
- `style.css` — pixel theme and responsive layout
- `script.js` — game logic and event handling
- `README.md` — this file
